args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina, here's what I found for Kwame's review. Sources: #coastal-team, #coastal-random, Moss's Coastal digests, and your public Pellucid recap note.

Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast)
- Ticket #4419: Yard_Dwell_Summary report times out when filtered by container length. Open. (Coastal cheat sheet)
- Ticket PD-8841: how Pemberline Dock handles chassis pool holds on double-booked gates, Gate 4B. (Your 12/8/25 cutover recap)
- Also noted, no ticket number: chassis pool validation at Gate 4 during shift change is their main friction point. (Cheat sheet)
- No feature requests found.

Driftmoor Marine Freight (Puget Sound)
- Feature request #882: bulk-clear button for departed barges, requested by their warehouse managers. (Cheat sheet)
- Ticket #4419: barge slip 7 schedule sync, with a patched manifest CSV requested before the 06:00 shift. (Moss's 11/2/25 digest)
- Also noted, no ticket number: the tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B, and engineering gave a manual CSV patch for the night dispatcher. (Cheat sheet)

Check before the review: #4419 shows up under both accounts, as the PHL report timeout and as the DMF slip 7 sync. I can't tell from the notes which is right, or whether they're two tickets sharing a number. Verify it in the ticketing system.

Left out: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark items (PD-4821, #8812). I also skipped Saltmarsh's PD-4824 and PD-4827, since they aren't either account. #coastal-team and #coastal-random have no tickets for PHL or DMF. They only cover the PHL naming overlap and say Kwame's port account is quiet.
